title: Elmer Snowden and who brought the Puerto Ricans to the Howard
summary: He was not in New York when Snowden and Duke were downtown, and corrects Duke's book: bassist Escudero brought the 13 musicians, and Marie Lucas came later.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I was looking here at my notes from Duke's book, Music is My Mistress, and he says that Elmer Snowden came in with his banjo about the same time that he met you. Is that right? Elmer Snowden?
Well, no, I was not in New York when
Snowden and Duke was working downtown in that small club.
That was after you had met Duke, then? though?
Duke says that you -- I guess he had the story wrong, because he says that you came to the Howard with Marie Lucas from Puerto Rico -- with Marie Lucas.
No, no, no. But that was wrong -- I guess
Maybe he was confused. And then he mentioned that ....

No, the fellow that brought the band to the Howard Theatre was the bass player, which he had been in Washington for a long time playing for Andrew Toma, the owner. He'd been there, and the owner decided to send this fellow, Escudero, the bass player, to Puerto Rico to get the 13 musicians. [Ralph]
Uh huh. And So Marie Lucas came later?
